title: Gilded Chest
summary: Portable loot container that can be picked up or thrown. Both documented variants have 50 HP.

fields.Defences: Resistant to Piercing, Necrotic and Radiant, vulnerable to Bludgeoning, immune to Poison and Psychic.
fields.Heavy variant: 44 lb, 1 gp. Medium Toughness requires a single hit to deal at least 22 damage.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
